plan.target: Nominal added nutrient: 15 g fat or 10 g protein, not total meal macros.
plan.query: Every available repeat numbered >=3, identical queries for both counts.
plan.inclusion: At least three rice and three supplemented-condition sessions per person.
plan.representation: 0..170 minute smoothed curves minus median at -25,-20,-15 minutes, before nominal preload.
plan.conversion: Project query onto high-minus-low calibration mean curve; clip below zero only.
plan.limitations: Cross-condition dates unavailable; baseline spline is noncausal; intervention nutrition co-varies; only two people.
